thought.text:
This approach is fragile — `get_marked()` returns the whole line from the mark, and `endswith` on it is unreliable. Let me use a cleaner, more direct approach: capture the whitespace consumed by `_equal_sign` explicitly.

The `_equal_sign` regex is `(=[^\S\r\n]*)`. I can read the equal sign and its trailing whitespace separately, or better, check the character immediately before the current position. Let me rewrite using a dedicated peek at the raw string.
